figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastic reference to excessive or fruitless scholarship
similar_in_english: A little learning is a dangerous thing
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে শুধু পণ্ডিতি করে, কোনো কাজের কথা বলে না।
এই পণ্ডিতি করে কী লাভ? বাস্তব জীবনের সাথে মিলছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He just shows off his pedantry without saying anything useful.
What's the point of all this scholarship? It doesn't connect with real life.
note: Refers to mocking overly theoretical or unproductive knowledge in Bengali discourse
